experiments.study_type: Form deprivation myopia (FDM) and recovery with single-cell analysis of chick choroids
experiments.procedure_text: Apply translucent goggles to right eyes; leave left eyes untreated. After 24 hours of recovery, isolate choroidal cells for FACS and RNA sequencing and examine immunolabelled choroidal whole mounts.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: Form deprivation myopia (FDM) was induced in 3 to 4 day-old chicks by applying translucent plastic goggles
experiments.test_system_evidence: Choroids were isolated from control (left) eyes and eyes recovering from form deprivation myopia (right)
experiments.route_evidence: euthanized by an overdose of isoflurane inhalant anesthetic

experiments.notes: Goggles were checked daily in chicks aged 3–4 days at application; RNA sequencing used three pools of ten choroids per eye condition, and inhalation refers only to euthanasia. experiments.study_type: FACS sorting of CHRNA3-positive cells from normal chicken eyes
experiments.procedure_text: Fix and immunolabel choroidal cells from normal chicken eyes with anti-chick CHRNA3, label nuclei with DAPI, and analyze stained cells by flow cytometry.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: CHRNA3-positive cells were isolated from choroid tissue homogenates from normal chicken eyes by FACS
experiments.test_system_evidence: isolated from choroid tissue homogenates from normal chicken eyes by FACS

endpoints.evidence: cells were labelled only with AlexaFluor 647 and DAPI represented 0.11%

substances.name: DAPI
substances.evidence: nuclei were labelled with DAPI (1:1000 in wash buffer)

experiments.exposure_evidence: Cells were immunolabelled with anti-chick CHRNA3 (1:4000) in blocking buffer overnight 4°C with rotation.
experiments.notes: Normal-eye overlap with the paired-eye cohort is not stated. Cells were fixed in 4% formaldehyde overnight at 4°C and labelled with anti-CHRNA3 (1:4000) overnight at 4°C, secondary antibody (1:1000) for 1 hour at room temperature, and DAPI (1:1000); the nonspecific control used only the secondary antibody and DAPI.
